author: 4 Ever Green
description: Explore 21 real German machines across aviation, railways, military history, and heavy industry. From the propeller-driven Schienenzeppelin and twelve-engine Dornier Do X to Bagger 288 and the colossal Schwerer Gustav, every machine in this video was actually built. Which one surprised you most? Subscribe to 4 Ever Green for more incredible stories from history.
title: 21 Giant Soviet Machines That Actually Existed
